cohort: The study included 33,993 delivering women and 34,547 live births from eight hospitals in Sichuan province, China.
finding: The incidence of SMM was 43.4/1000 live births, and seven medical co-morbidities, including iron-deficiency anemia, other hematological diseases, hepatitis-B virus infection, other hepatic diseases, cardiopathy, hypertension, and respiratory diseases, were identified as significant independent contributors to SMM.
